clue.text: A king once and a king one day?

definitions.text: A king once and a king one day?

parts.words: A king once and a king one day?
parts.note: a nod to the legend of the once and future king, a ruler of old who is said to return to reign again

explanation.surface: A riddle about someone who was a monarch long ago and will be again.
explanation.walkthrough: T. H. White's novel The Once and Future King tells the legend of the Briton who ruled Camelot and is said to sleep until he is needed again.
explanation.definitionFit: The legendary British monarch of Camelot was a ruler in the past and, by legend, will reign again in the future.

clue.text: Tries participating in actual practice session

indicators.note: something participating in a word sits within it, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: actual means real
a judge tries or hears a case in court

explanation.surface: Attempts made during a genuine training session.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tries' looks like attempts, but here it is the court sense: a judge hears a case.
explanation.definitionFit: A rehearsal is the practice run of a play or performance before it is staged.

clue.text: Girl taken in by builder's carrier is a rash one

indicators.note: the girl is taken in, enclosed, by the carrier, so her name goes inside it

parts.note: a hod is the trough a builder uses to carry bricks
Thea is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A young woman picked up by a bricklayer turns out to be reckless.
explanation.definitionFit: A hothead is an impetuous person who acts rashly without thinking.

clue.text: Letter wanting small house by river

parts.note: HO is a short form of house, as in a company name

explanation.surface: A note sent by someone who wants a little cottage by the water.
explanation.walkthrough: 'small' signals the shortened form of house; 'wanting' and 'by' just link the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Rho is the seventeenth character of the Greek alphabet.

clue.text: Outlook for faction without power

parts.note: pro means for, in favour of

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the faction goes around the power

parts.note: a sect is a faction or splinter group
P is the physics abbreviation for power

explanation.surface: The future looks bleak for a political group that has lost its influence.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' looks like lacking, but here it means outside: SECT wraps round P.
explanation.definitionFit: A prospect is a view or expectation of what is to come, an outlook.

clue.text: Swivel camera towards something on stage

parts.note: to pan is to swing a camera round horizontally
to means towards

explanation.surface: A film-maker turns the lens towards the action on stage.
explanation.walkthrough: A panto (pantomime) is a British Christmas stage show for families.
explanation.definitionFit: A pantomime is a theatrical entertainment, so it is a thing put on in a theatre.

clue.text: Hack in from Scots river that's remote

parts.note: out of means from, as in made out of

indicators.note: the hacking word is placed in the other pieces

parts.note: the Tay is a river in Scotland
to hew is to hack or chop

explanation.surface: Someone chops their way in after coming from a distant Scottish river.
explanation.definitionFit: Somewhere out of the way is isolated or remote, far from the usual routes.

clue.text: Compile sloppily, getting strong verbal attack

indicators.note: done sloppily, carelessly, the letters of the word are jumbled

explanation.surface: A careless editor gets a fierce verbal broadside.
explanation.definitionFit: A polemic is a forceful written or spoken attack on an opinion or person.

clue.text: Caught inferior new comic

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
low means inferior or base

explanation.surface: A poor new comedian is caught out.
explanation.definitionFit: A clown is a comic performer, a joker who makes people laugh.

clue.text: Demonstrated about United's factory closure

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so one word goes around the other

parts.note: demonstrated means shown
UTD is the usual abbreviation for United in football club names

explanation.surface: Workers protested about the football club's plant closing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Demonstrated' suggests protesting, but it just means shown.
explanation.definitionFit: A shutdown is the closing of a factory or plant, stopping its work.

clue.text: Regularly at fault with deep burning fat

indicators.note: regularly means taking every other letter of the following words

parts.note: a deep voice is a low one

explanation.surface: Someone repeatedly at fault with a deep-fat fryer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Regularly' takes the even letters of 'at fault', giving TAL.
explanation.definitionFit: Tallow is animal fat that was burned in candles and lamps.

clue.text: What failed for wet OAP, right?

definitions.text: What failed for wet OAP, right?

indicators.note: something that has failed has gone wrong, so the letters are broken up and rearranged

explanation.surface: Asking which garment let down a soaked pensioner.
explanation.walkthrough: An OAP is an old-age pensioner. The whole clue defines the coat that let the pensioner get wet.
explanation.definitionFit: A waterproof coat is exactly the item that should have kept a rained-on pensioner dry.

clue.text: Unreasonable factiousness in festive atmosphere

definitions.meaning: blind loyalty to one's own political side
the jolly mood of a celebration

explanation.surface: Partisan bickering ruining a celebration.
explanation.definitionFit: Party spirit means both partisan zeal for a political party and the jolly mood at a celebration.

clue.text: Improve finish on motorway

indicators.note: in an across answer, the finish comes on, after, the motorway

parts.note: M is the abbreviation for motorway, as in M1
end means finish

explanation.surface: Make things better at the end of the motorway.
explanation.definitionFit: To mend something is to repair it or make it better.

clue.text: With safety device defective from the start, it must be second-hand

indicators.note: lacking from the start means the first letter is removed

parts.note: fused means fitted with a fuse, an electrical safety device

explanation.surface: A gadget with a faulty safety cut-out must have had a previous owner.
explanation.definitionFit: Used goods have had an earlier owner, so they are second-hand.

clue.text: Run-down sheep has impediments

parts.note: a ram is a male sheep
to shackle is to impede, and shackles are restraints that hamper movement

explanation.surface: A tired-out sheep is held back by restraints.
explanation.definitionFit: Something ramshackle is dilapidated, in poor repair, falling apart.

clue.text: Six furlongs? Vastly shorter length

definitions.meaning: eight furlongs make a mile, so six is three quarters of it, playfully the first three of its four letters
a thousandth of an inch, a tiny unit of measure

explanation.surface: Asking about a racing distance and a much smaller measure.
explanation.definitionFit: A mil is a thousandth of an inch, far shorter than any racing distance.

clue.text: Making even Neville confused in Algy's heart

indicators.note: the jumbled name is put in the middle letters
the heart of a word is its middle letters
confused means the letters of the name are jumbled

explanation.surface: A muddled Neville is at the centre of Algy's affections.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heart' takes only the middle pair of Algy, ignoring the possessive, and 'in' wraps that pair round the jumbled name.
explanation.definitionFit: Levelling a surface is making it flat and even.

clue.text: Expose illegitimate child, with no detail spared

parts.note: to blow a secret or a cover is to expose it
a by-blow is an old word for a child born outside marriage

explanation.surface: Reveal a love-child, recounting every particular.
explanation.definitionFit: A blow-by-blow account gives every detail in sequence, missing nothing.

clue.text: Carefully consider reported damage to top of Kentish footpath sign

indicators.note: reported means said aloud, so the word is replaced by one that sounds the same

parts.note: to weigh something is to consider it carefully
to mar is to damage

indicators.note: the top of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Think hard about the vandalism at the start of a walking trail in Kent.
explanation.definitionFit: A waymark is a marker or post that shows walkers the route of a footpath.

clue.text: Wander across, then run to the front

indicators.note: brought to the front means moved to the start of the word

parts.note: over means across, as in over the road
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: Stroll across the road, then dash ahead.
explanation.definitionFit: To rove is to roam or wander without a fixed destination.

clue.text: Old clothing with tear around end

indicators.note: the tear goes around the goal word, enclosing it

parts.note: a rent is a tear or rip in cloth
an aim is an end or goal

explanation.surface: Antique garments with a rip around the hem.
explanation.walkthrough: 'end' looks like the edge of the cloth, but here it is a goal, an aim.
explanation.definitionFit: Raiment is an archaic, literary word for clothing.

clue.text: Acceptable wine if reduced in temperature

indicators.note: reduced in the temperature letter means losing T, the abbreviation for temperature

parts.note: Tokay is a sweet Hungarian wine

explanation.surface: Wine is fine if it is chilled.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reduced in temperature' reads like chilling, but it means removing T.
explanation.definitionFit: Okay means satisfactory or acceptable.

clue.text: One who wrote of Flaubert's head being inspired by parrot

indicators.note: inspired in its literal sense of breathed in, so the letter goes inside the bird

parts.note: the kaka is a New Zealand parrot

indicators.note: the head of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A writer on the French novelist whose ideas came from a parrot.
explanation.walkthrough: Flaubert wrote a story about a parrot, which makes the surface plausible.
explanation.definitionFit: Franz Kafka was a Czech writer of novels such as The Trial, so he is one who wrote.

clue.text: Rev. Spooner's fussy with food, removed skin from rice starter?

indicators.note: Spooner swapped the opening sounds of words, so the first sounds of the two words change places

parts.note: faddy means fussy about what one eats
peeled means had its skin taken off

explanation.surface: A picky eater who has skinned something for the start of a rice dish.
explanation.walkthrough: Swapping the opening F and P sounds of FADDY PEELED gives words said like PADDY FIELD.
explanation.definitionFit: A paddy field is the flooded field where rice is grown, where the crop starts.

clue.text: Doctor taking oxygen to work, a sign of weariness?

parts.note: O is the chemical symbol for oxygen
op is short for opus, a work

explanation.surface: A doctor needs oxygen to keep going when exhausted.
explanation.definitionFit: Drooping, sagging or flagging, is a typical sign of tiredness.

clue.text: Romance needs a fine and loud melody

parts.note: F is the abbreviation for fine, as on pencils
F is forte, the musical direction for loud
an air is a melody or tune

explanation.surface: Love needs a good, rousing tune.
explanation.definitionFit: An affair is a romance, a love relationship.

clue.text: Broadcast not, I hear, being transmitted

indicators.note: broadcast in its sense of scattered widely, so the letters are scattered and rearranged

explanation.surface: A programme supposedly not broadcast, so the rumour goes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Broadcast' reads as the definition but it is the anagram signal; 'I hear' looks like a sound signal but is fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: A programme that is on the air is being broadcast at that moment.

clue.text: Untidy home? Mine's all upside-down

indicators.note: in a down answer, turned upside-down means written bottom to top

parts.note: a pit is a mine

explanation.surface: A messy house where everything is topsy-turvy.
explanation.definitionFit: A tip is British slang for an untidy, messy place, like a rubbish dump.

clue.text: Supports champion baseball catch-. er

parts.note: to back someone is to support them
top means best, a champion

explanation.surface: Fans support the best catcher in baseball.
explanation.definitionFit: In baseball the backstop is the catcher, who stands behind home plate.

clue.text: Red wine's needed here, but not in. soup
